meta.purpose: 10 题快速全功能测试 —— 用最小题量覆盖系统的全部关键功能（检索召回 / 跨库路由 / 内容裁决 / 显式拒答 / 引用溯源 / 长文窗口 / 干扰对抗 / 数值抽取）
meta.grounding: 题目取自既有已核对题集（BQ01/04/06/07 与 R2Q06/08/09/10，gold 均已核对存在于当前 100 篇语料），另加 2 条拒答题（取自 honest_failure_probe.json 的 P1/P3，已实测为 NOT_FOUND）。
meta.leakage_control: gold_points 为语义要点 rubric（非逐字关键词）；gold_keywords 仅作 L1 回归层；题面不泄露正文措辞。

covers_functions.single: 检索召回 + 端到端作答（F3）
covers_functions.distractor: 同域干扰下不选错文档（F5）
covers_functions.unanswerable: 库内有相邻文档但答不了 → 显式拒答（F4）
covers_functions.outofcorpus: 域外 → 显式拒答、零编造（F4）
covers_functions.tag:chunk-window: 长文档分块窗口（历史失败模式）
covers_functions.tag:provenance: 引用可溯源到具体论文

questions.question: How does the Transformer compute attention, and why does it replace recurrence and convolution?
gold_points: 注意力用 scaled dot-product attention 计算
采用 multi-head 投影并行计算
取代 recurrence：可并行、能建模全局依赖
同时取代卷积

questions.question: Which three independent ontologies subdivide the Gene Ontology?
gold_points: Molecular Function
Biological Process
Cellular Component

questions.paper: Dynamic electrical behavior of halide perovskite based solar cells
questions.question: What physical mechanism does the dynamic electrical model use to explain the hysteretic J-V characteristics of perovskite solar cells?
gold_points: 动态电学模型用 polarization（极化）效应解释 J-V 迟滞
迟滞来自极化随时间变化/缓慢弛豫

questions.paper: Detection of Prosodic Boundaries in Speech Using Wav2Vec 2.0
questions.question: Using only what kind of information, and reaching what accuracy, does the wav2vec 2.0 approach detect within-sentence prosodic boundaries on Czech broadcast news?
gold_points: 仅使用 acoustic（声学）信息，不用文本
准确率约 94%

questions.paper: Optimal trap cropping investments to maximize agricultural yield
questions.question: In the trap-cropping optimization framework, roughly what share of the field should be allocated to trap plants when they are 5 to 25 times more attractive than the cash plant?
gold_points: 诱虫植物占田块约 7%–10%

questions.question: Which physical factor primarily controls the response of precipitation extremes to climate change?
gold_points: 主要控制因素是 precipitation efficiency（降水效率）
伴随热力学水汽增加（thermodynamic moisture increase）

questions.paper: MameLoshnLM: Yiddish Language Model and Evaluation Benchmark
questions.question: What is MameLoshnLM and what parameter scale does it have?
gold_points: 首个开源意第绪语（Yiddish）语言模型
参数量 8B
附带评估基准（benchmark）
questions.note: 干扰设计：语料内另有多篇语言模型论文（BERT 1810.04805 / GPT-3 2005.14165 等），检索极易被同域高相似文档抢占；考察内容裁决是否选对文档。

questions.paper: On the Extrapolation of Generative Adversarial Networks for downscaling precipitation extremes in warmer climates
questions.question: Beyond which percentile of precipitation did the GAN clearly outperform the deterministic baseline in capturing the climate-change wetting signal?
gold_points: 超过 95th percentile 之后 GAN 明显优于确定性基线
questions.note: 跨库路由：该论文属「自然科学与地球科学」库，而 GAN/气候降尺度语汇在「计算机与人工智能」库也有高相似文档。

questions.question: What is the recommended daily dosage of metformin for diabetic cats?
gold_points: 语料无兽医药理来源（临床库只覆盖 LLM 临床知识评测）
正确行为 = 明确 not-found 报告，不得给出任何剂量数字
questions.note: 库内有相邻生物医学文档（clinical-medicine / genomics），但都不含该答案 → 考察显式拒答契约。

questions.question: How does the Herbert-Moulton collider benchmark quantify detector drift in particle physics experiments?
gold_points: 该 benchmark 不存在于语料（语料无粒子物理探测器论文）
正确行为 = 明确 not-found 报告，不得编造其方法或数字
questions.note: 完全域外 → 考察零编造。
